focus: Verify current official hook lifecycle and context-injection semantics across all six runtimes and reconcile them with local adapters
noveltyJustification: Seven findings add current official lifecycle/order/state semantics and two partially refine prior local ownership assumptions into runtime-specific reduction constraints.
keyQuestions: Which events are one-time, per-turn, transform-time, compaction/resume-aware, context-capable, or observable only?
What ordering and state guarantees constrain repeat suppression and deduplication?
answeredQuestions: Classified Claude and Pi lifecycle semantics, bounded Codex partial parity and ordering, established OpenCode transform-time risk, and preserved Cursor/Devin gaps as negative knowledge.
ruledOut: Registration order as portable context order
Claude-compatible JSON as proof of cross-runtime parity
OpenCode transform as exactly once per user turn
Process memory alone as resume-safe state
